description.value: Captain Meat & Poultry is a BC-wide franchise specialty meat and poultry shop with over 10 years of experience, preparing fresh products using exotic Indian spices and proprietary recipes. The Nanaimo location offers items including raw goat meat, achar goat, and turkey, making it a distinctive stop for cyclists seeking specialty protein. It is part of a growing chain with locations across the Lower Mainland and Vancouver Island.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Nanaimo location at 1708 Bowen Rd with phone +16042850500, matching the OSM phone number. The site is a multi-location BC franchise meat shop specializing in fresh and cooked meat/poultry products prepared with Indian spices; no cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags. One discrepancy: OSM includes addr:unit '24' but the website lists no unit number for the Nanaimo location, and the contact page lists the Nanaimo location without a phone, while the Richmond location also uses (604) 285-0500.
